findings.title: Footer says current page, uses all filtered rows

findings.impact: The label misleads users, and a very large report could throw a RangeError on Maximum or Minimum.
findings.fix: Change the wording to match the rows used, or use getRowModel(); fold min and max with reduce instead of spread.
findings.evidence:
? "From the current page. Click for the total"
